Thanks Rafael — quick debrief after the onsite this morning: Vela is strong on runtime performance work (KV cache optimizations, batching heuristics) and has led cross-functional rollouts at ByteWave. My recommendation: offer at high end of Sr band with a stretch expectation; however, given the cross-team product leadership ask, I'm requesting a level exception to Staff Inference Engineer.

Proposed package (for approval):
- Level: Staff (exception request)
- Base: $240,000
- Target OTE (base + equity target vests): ~$325k total comp
- Signing bonus: $15k (one-time)
- Relocation: N/A; remote-west

Rationale for exception: will own inference runtime roadmap for a new dedup/caching initiative and will be the single lead for low-latency routing integrations. This is beyond typical Sr scope and will reduce cross-team handoffs.

I've attached the comp_band_proposal_v2.xlsx — the band supports up to $235k for Sr; $240k would exceed by $5k. I can make a case for $240k if comp committee signs off on the strategic ownership clause.
